evidence: Starting from Whangaparapara Road, the Kaitoke Hot Springs Track begins flat and easy, following an ancient shoreline.
After a brief steep climb and descent, join Tramline Track North, which harbours reminders of the toil of loggers 80 years ago.
Peach Tree Track soon appears on the left and you climb steadily through the regenerating forest to reach Mt Heale Hut.
The last day is an easy grade route with no major climbs following Forest Road.
From Forest Road follow the historic Tramline Track to The Green campsite.
You can camp at The Green campsite at Whangaparapara or exit onto Whangaparapara Road.

evidence: Alternative access to the Mt Heale Hut is possible from the east, via Windy Canyon and Palmers Track, accessed from Aotea Road at the top of Whangapoua Hill.
This section is fully bridged and is the shortest and easiest option for the first day.
From here take South Fork Track along and down to Mt Heale Hut.

doubts: W1 is the main way, from Kaitoke Hot Springs Track at Whangaparapara Road to Whangaparapara Road by Forest Road and the historic Tramline Track. Its end is F7 (where Tramline Track South meets Whangaparapara Road): the text says only 'exit onto Whangaparapara Road' after the Tramline Track to The Green campsite, so this is an inference from the feature. The page says the track can be walked in reverse; that is the same walk the other way, not a separate way. W2 is the Windy Canyon section, with its own heading and time; it ends at Mt Heale Hut, and the main way continues from there, since the page says it is the first day's alternative to Mt Heale Hut. Its time (3 hr - 3 hr 30 min) covers only that section. The summit on the Windy Canyon section is not named (possibly Mt Hobson), so it has no ref. The Mt Hobson side trip's departure point is not stated, so from is null. The Tramline Track name 'historic Tramline Track' does not match a named entry, so its ref is null. Maungapiko Lookout and Kauri Tree Route are named as 'on route' in the text, so they are recorded as via places; they may be short detours, and the page does not place them. Getting to the island by boat or plane, and Claris airfield, are not part of the walk; Claris is recorded as not on route. DOC's time '2-3 days' is copied for the main way.
